title: taste-velocity
description: I7 Taste Velocity: per-genre share of PLAYS in the rolling last window_days, against the same share over the whole Plex play history. delta = recent_share - lifetime_share; positive is heating, negative is cooling. Rows are sorted by |delta| descending and capped at 14. Source is watch behaviour, NOT ratings - the Trakt ratings file on this box is a frozen snapshot and could only ever produce a delta of zero. plays_recent and plays_lifetime are the genre-MAPPED play counts that are the actual denominators (unmapped plays are reported in note, never hidden); a title carries several genres, so shares do not sum to 1. plays_recent is the honest sample size and a card must surface it - the household shares one Plex account, so kids' viewing is inside these numbers, which is exactly what note exists to say.
